ai_briefing.morning_summary: Crypto markets are marginally down with Bitcoin at $83,784 (-0.38%) and ETH slipping, while BNB shows a modest gain. Bitcoin hovers just below the $84k psychological level ahead of key PCE inflation data and Micron earnings, and continued ETF inflows provide a slight tailwind. New token listings on Delta India add modest upside potential but overall sentiment remains cautious.
